deleteAgent.title: Delete agent {{id}}?
deleteAgent.body: Its settings file is removed. Past runs, results and saved versions stay.

copyAgent.bodyDuplicate: Makes a new agent from this agent's settings, skills and tools. The copy starts at version 1.
copyAgent.bodyRename: Rename makes {{new}} from this agent's settings and removes {{old}}. Past runs, results and saved versions keep the name {{old}}.
